entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnetup: Walkthrough UX improvements (tracking issue) #53844
  • dotnetup: Add scroll indicator hint to channel selector #53843
  • dotnetup: Improve walkthrough subtitle text #53842
  • dotnetup: Duplicate installs shown in system install migration list #53841
  • dotnetup: Consider renaming `walkthrough` command to `init` or alternative #53840
  • dotnetup: Add `dotnetup migrate` command for system-to-local install conversion #53839
  • dotnetup: Migrate mode selector to two sequential y/n prompts #53838
  • dotnetup: Migrate walkthrough to summary-based approach #53837
  • Error when attempting to `apt-get install dotnet-sdk-10.0` on Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS #53834

Closed

  • The launch notation for file based apps is broken, and no correct notation seems to exist #53810
  • Container base image inference uses wrong Ubuntu codename for .NET 11 #53553
  • Documentation link for diagnostic ID NU1510 does not forward correctly. #53832

PullRequests

Created

  • Add zstd compression and Compression Dictionary Transport (CDT) support for static web assets #53836
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Use MSBuild CommandLineParser for terminal logger detection #53835
    Area-CLI
  • Warn about common run-file pitfalls #53833
    Area-run-file
  • Fix gitignore template: add \r\r to the Icon entry #53830
    Area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • Reapply "Migrate test infrastructure from xUnit v2 to xUnit v3 (#52930)" #53809
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Use `source-build-assets` repo #53811
  • Fix `dotnet clean file-based-apps` in docs #53806
    documentation, Area-run-file
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #53824
  • Re-apply OTel telemetry changes (un-revert #53181) #53800

Updated

  • Update long path instructions in developer guide #53846
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53759
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53795
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #53679
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53758
  • Implement `#:ref` directive for file-based apps #53480
    Area-run-file
  • Merge dotnet/templating into dotnet/sdk (Phase 2: build integration and ProjectReference conversion) #53680
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix dotnet tool runner stripping duplicate flags when rollForward is enabled #53725
  • Introduce a property to specify assemblies that should be partially R2R compiled and excluded from a composite image. #53635
    Area-ReadyToRun, sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Validate descriptor from registry + add tests for descriptor resolution #53724
    Area-Containers
  • Keep strong reference to virtual project's ProjectRootElement to prevent GC #53807
    Area-run-file
  • Fix `dotnet new install` help text to use `@` instead of deprecated `::` for version syntax #53829
  • Auto-enable DOTNET_CLI_CONTEXT_VERBOSE for diagnostic verbosity #52222
  • Fix nuget subcommand --help forwarding to NuGet CLI #53723
  • [watch] Fixes command line parsing and TFM selection for FBAs #53698
  • Fix reporting Hot Reload capabilities of WASM projects #53665
  • Add mixed installation detection and warning to `dotnet --info` #51127
    stale
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Fix dotnet tool runner stripping duplicate flags when rollForward is enabled #53821
    backport
